title: Heat exchanger data sheets: five inputs that matter
summary: Thermal duty, stream conditions and maintenance considerations are essential to sound equipment selection.
body:
Early exchanger proposals depend on accurate stream information and clear constraints. Five useful input groups are: flow rate; inlet and outlet conditions; fluid properties; pressure drop and fouling allowances; and material/code requirements.

A budgetary proposal should clearly distinguish confirmed client data from vendor assumptions, especially before mechanical drawings and final thermal calculations are approved.
seoTitle: Heat Exchanger Data Sheet Guide | Tongyang Process
seoDescription: Key process and mechanical inputs for preparing an industrial heat exchanger inquiry.
